turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, quick question first. I have a small dog. Is that allowed at the Elm Road flat?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Pets are decided property by property and need the landlord's written consent, so I can't promise yes or no right now. I can ask the landlord for you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, please do. It's a small terrier, very quiet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted, a small terrier. I'll put the request to the landlord today and call you back by Thursday with their answer. Is this the best number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Speak to you by Thursday. Thanks for your time.
